title: An agentic framework for gravitational-wave counterpart association in the multi-messenger era
abstract: arXiv:2605.10584v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the detection of gravitational waves (GWs), multi-messenger astronomy has opened a new window for advancing our understanding of astrophysics, dense matter, gravitation, and cosmology. The GW sources detected to date are from mergers of compact object binaries, which possess the potential to generate detectable electromagnetic (EM) counterparts. Searching for associations between GW signals and their EM counterparts is an essential step toward enabling subsequent multi-messenger studies. In the era of next-generation GW and EM detectors, the rapid increase in the number of events brings not only unprecedented scientific opportunities, but also substantial challenges to the existing data analysis paradigm. translated_title: 多信使时代引力波对应体关联的智能体框架
translated_abstract: 随着引力波（GW）的成功探测，多信使天文学为推进我们对天体物理、致密物质、引力以及宇宙学的理解开辟了新的窗口。迄今为止探测到的引力波源均来自致密星双星的并合，这些天体具有产生可探测电磁（EM）对应体的潜力。搜索引力波信号与其电磁对应体之间的关联，是开展后续多信使研究的关键一步。在下一代引力波和电磁探测器的时代，事件数量的快速增长不仅带来了前所未有的科学机遇，也对现有的数据分析范式构成了重大挑战。为帮助应对这些挑战，我们开发了GW-Eyes——一个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体框架。GW-Eyes首次集成了领域专用工具，并能自主完成对应体关联任务。
tldr: 本文提出了GW-Eyes，一个由大语言模型驱动的智能体框架，首次集成领域专用工具并自主完成引力波事件与电磁对应体的关联，以应对下一代探测器时代海量事件带来的数据分析挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GW-Eyes, an agentic framework powered by large language models that for the first time integrates domain-specific tools to autonomously perform gravitational-wave counterpart association, addressing the data analysis challenges posed by the surge of events in the era of next-generation detectors.
